title: Shrink the 4 functions in go/internal/cyclesimulator and go/cmd/testlatency over the 50-line limit and drop them from the size ratchet's offender list
summary: The repo-wide size ratchet (go/internal/sizeratchet, cycle 1726) lists every function over 50 lines with an allowance that may only shrink. These are the listed offenders in go/internal/cyclesimulator and go/cmd/testlatency: cmd/testlatency.Parse (69 lines), cmd/testlatency.Report.Markdown (60 lines), internal/cyclesimulator.Run (152 lines), internal/cyclesimulator.appendSimLedger (71 lines). Each should do one thing at one level of abstraction (Clean Code, skills/engineering-craft/references/clean-code.md): extract named steps until every function is 50 lines or fewer, with behavior unchanged.
acceptance: Every listed function in go/internal/cyclesimulator and go/cmd/testlatency is 50 lines or fewer, and its entry is removed from go/internal/sizeratchet/offenders.json (the ratchet test passes).
Behavior is unchanged: the package's existing tests pass unmodified; a function without a test that pins its behavior gets a characterization test first, red on a mutant.
No comments are added (docs/conventions/code-comments.md); names carry the intent.
priority_rationale: wave 21 boundary 2026-09-28: real clean-code debt the ratchet now tracks; lane-sized, behavior-preserving refactors on non-protected packages
